description: This file defines the Coupon controller class for the OpenCart checkout process, handling coupon display, save, and removal functionalities.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing coupon-related actions in checkout, including displaying, saving, and removing coupons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the coupon information if the total_coupon_status is enabled, rendering the coupon view with relevant data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a coupon entered by the user, validating it, updating session data, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the applied coupon from the session, clearing related session data, and returns success or error messages in JSON format.
